cases.prompt: Review a long App manual, keep its complete workflow together unless a child topic has an independent reader goal, and verify the generated site after any justified split.
cases.rationale: Reader architecture, page types, movement, and renderer output are in scope.

cases.prompt: Add complete public MATLAB help for a new facade function and update its reference page.
cases.rationale: Public API reference is an authored documentation contract.

cases.prompt: Prepare user-facing notes for a published LabKit release and keep PR validation evidence out of the public page.
cases.rationale: Release documentation and fact-lifecycle ownership are in scope.

cases.prompt: Before publishing the next LabKit release, compare it with the immediately preceding published tag and ensure every App and workflow added across several merged PRs appears in the release notes.
cases.rationale: Complete tag-to-tag release coverage and reconciliation of user-visible changes are release documentation work.

cases.prompt: Migrate an accepted component change into the new structured change schema, keep its durable rationale with the change, and link the superseding Change chain.
cases.rationale: Structured changes, supersession relationships, and history migration are documentation architecture work.

cases.prompt: Add a new App guide and make it discoverable from the Launcher, App family, API ownership, Changes, breadcrumbs, search, and the generated documentation map without adding a hand-written global catalog.
cases.rationale: Reader paths, semantic routes, generated navigation, component relationships, and renderer validation are documentation maintenance.

cases.prompt: The development landing sends readers into a separate maintenance tree for testing and release. Rework the whole information architecture so top-level sections use one reader-intent axis and core journeys stay inside one section.
cases.rationale: Competing top-level classifications, page movement, navigation, and reader-journey continuity are documentation architecture work.

cases.prompt: Add a public labkit.image function, write its complete MATLAB help, and verify that the package guide, Reference catalog, search, and generated function page expose it without a handwritten route.
cases.rationale: A new public source contract requires current help and generated documentation discovery.

cases.prompt: Change an App's button label, default export name, recovery error, and output fields; update or create every current reader owner and preserve the accepted rationale once.
cases.rationale: Changed user-visible behavior, defaults, errors, outputs, current manuals, and Change ownership are documentation maintenance.

cases.prompt: Retire a public App API and its workflow. Remove obsolete help, current guidance, links, generated discovery, and the former route while linking the supported replacement and recording compatibility impact.
cases.rationale: Retiring a public reader surface requires coordinated deletion and current replacement discovery without legacy routes.

cases.prompt: Audit a source refactor and prove whether it requires documentation creation, update, retirement, or no current-documentation change before the PR is prepared.
cases.rationale: The request explicitly asks for documentation-impact classification across source and reader contracts.

cases.prompt: Rename a private MATLAB local variable without changing help or user behavior.
cases.rationale: A source-only private rename has no authored documentation contract.

cases.prompt: Fix a numerical formula while leaving its documented scientific contract unchanged.
cases.rationale: The source correction alone does not require documentation architecture work.

cases.prompt: Move a private helper into another private folder without changing callers, behavior, help, or reader discovery.
cases.rationale: A verified internal move has no current reader contract to maintain.
